training_method.timing: Hardware full/crop/excerpt pins unchanged. Software absolute time=source_start+sample_time-93/44100. No fitted alignment.
training_method.closure: Reuse pinned first-note 300–1500/1500–12000Hz Hann1024/hop44 mid, five-frame median, early15–35ms, late75–95ms, shifts -10/0/+10ms, existing sustained10/20/30dB crossing method with censored landmarks. Preserve original and common support guard;512/2048 and L/R remain secondary.
training_method.amplitude_vector: Early/late absolute high-to-low ratio, raw high/low/25–200Hz band powers, late high and late low each divided by the same early low power, separate high/low/bass changes, and direct PCM RMS. No per-band normalization or late-level gain fitting.
training_method.first_note_harmonics: Reuse pinned centers80/90/100ms after fixed first onset and40ms windows, same joint DC/trend plus40-harmonic nuisance-frequency fitting and residual reporting. Dynamic-window harmonic results are descriptive and phase-sensitive.
training_method.long_fourth_harmonics: Reuse original hardware endpoint center times21.830/21.840/21.850s, widths30/40/60ms where present in the pinned source method, the same16-harmonic joint DC/trend fit and95–110Hz nuisance search. Retain each paired observation and residual, no altered window or fundamental selection.
training_method.long_fourth_levels: Reuse declared early15–35ms and late175–225ms,1024/mid primary with +/-10ms,512/2048/LR secondary and common full-support guard.
training_method.denominator_guard: Retain raw H1 and H2 amplitude/power and fit residuals. Do not treat tiny/cancelled denominators as valid improvements or invent a new floor/winner rule. Hn/H2 is undefined at zero H2; weak-fit cases remain explicitly unresolved.
training_method.software_only_causal_deltas: Centering delta separately within hardClip and linearCenterTanh, beside matched tanh/linearized centering deltas, for late shape and first/fourth band vectors. This is model sensitivity, not proof of a hardware circuit.
training_method.optional_read_only_trace: If instrumentation is available, retain prefilter/postfilter/pre-OD/post-OD Upper AC/DC/RMS, Upper and Lower output stems, and nonlinear-limit activation counts at fixed windows. Taps must not alter processing; identity-control output must remain bit exact.

comparison_protocol.primary: Full per-cell fixed vector: late H3/H2,H4/H2 plus H2/H1, raw harmonic amplitudes/powers and residuals; first/fourth early and late band/RMS powers, changes and sustained closure/censoring under original and common guards. No scalar score or sorted winner.
comparison_protocol.common_closure_guard: Retain original rows unchanged and separately compute off minus15ms minus existing30ms guard, same source/candidate mask and10ms sustained method. Compare like guards only; preserve hardware censoring.
comparison_protocol.paired_controls: Within each fixed attack/depth/centering context, compare each new transfer with prior tanh and linearized control vectors and each fixed late-window ratio. Report signed differences, never normalize per band or fit gain, phase, onset or performance.
comparison_protocol.causal_contrasts: Centering delta separately within hardClip and linearCenterTanh, beside matched tanh/linearized centering deltas, for late shape and first/fourth band vectors. This is model sensitivity, not proof of a hardware circuit.
comparison_protocol.no_new_optimization: No changed windows, filters, source encodes, harmonic count/search, phase, onset, crossing thresholds, landmark support, fit family or scalar selection after results. All A02 observations are already seen diagnostic training.

phase_limits.why_exclude_H1: A clean Lower sine can add/cancel the Upper fundamental, moving every Hn/H1 ratio together. Under a stationary clean Lower, linear unclipped part/output sum and trustworthy fit, H3/H2 and H4/H2 remove this H1 denominator ambiguity.
phase_limits.limits: Envelope modulation, overlapping Lower releases, finite-window leakage, source processing or nonlinear final sum can violate pure-sine isolation. Check fit quality and power, and keep the caveat attached. A phase change between Upper Square and octave-higher Pulse can change nonlinear H2+ content; the fixed phase does not identify a global law.
phase_limits.sine_phase_guard: Not crossed into the24-cell mechanism screen. Only if a frozen promising mechanism improves H2-referenced shape while H1-referenced results remain ambiguous, a separately declared Lower-sine-only0/.25/.5/.75-cycle guard may test fundamental cancellation; hold phase fixed for the entire sequence and never pick the best phase per note/window. All phases report as nuisance range, not measured hardware phase.
phase_limits.upper_phase_guard: No Upper-phase fit in this screen. Any apparent nonlinear/DC mechanism remains conditional on fixed Upper Square/Pulse relative phase; a later independently declared guard would be needed before family-wide conclusions.

a03_supplemental_endpoint.note: Wet output with moving channel notches; preserve each matched window/channel. No aggregate pass or dry transfer inference.
a03_supplemental_endpoint.qualification: Wet-output, time/channel-dependent notches; preserve each source encode/channel rather than treating widest source range as a pass.

independent_calculation.status: Independent stationary analytic software check; no instrument audio, taps, hardware measurements or candidate fitting.

formulas.coarse: Non-WIDE wire -36 converts to physical -12 semitones.
formulas.interpolator_baseband_gain: .5+2*sum_j(c_j*cos(omega*(2*j+1-2*p))), omega=2*pi*f/(2*slow_rate); multiply outer and inner responses. Baseband component only; excludes interpolation images.
formulas.stationary_DC_unity: At fixed point, integrator updates require v1=0 and v2=input; each LP stage therefore preserves DC below its state limiter.
formulas.stationary_amplitude_bound: Any periodic waveform confined to |x|<=M has Fourier H1 amplitude <=4*M/pi. Estimated H1>4/pi excludes remaining entirely inside +/-1 under stated stationary assumptions; H1 itself is not the instantaneous peak.

source_references.claim: balanceLegGain gives unity both legs at0; voiced law.
TPT LP taps and two-stage cascade; unityDC in unsaturated fixed state.
Drive pregain law and subsequent compensation.
Filter output entersOD before AMP envelope.
Voice headroom and other output scaling occur after renderVoiceTick.
Half-band upsampling uses direct even plus doubledodd-tap sum.
Non-WIDE signed wire coarse divided by3.

independent_calculation.interpretation: The stationary square contribution alone exceeds the fixed linear-center scales after existing pregain. Octave-higher Pulse has no f component in the ideal stationary periodic model and analytic mean subtraction changes DC, not square H1. Quiet final output does not establish quiet OD input because AMP/level/velocity/pan/headroom/output scaling follow the nonlinearity.
limits: Stationary current-model coefficients and filter-envelope endpoint assumed; dynamic envelope/filter settling, branch limiter activity, finite-window leakage and waveform alias images are excluded.
Not measured internal sample minima/maxima, threshold-occupancy fractions or a tapped runtime trajectory.
No statement about actual Roland oscillator gain, mix normalization, shaper threshold, topology or capture gain.

builder_post_OD_example.assumptions: Settled Upper amp sustain, center pan, no tremolo, full enable/expression/tone balance/patch level. Not a measured late-note gain; analog output and reconstruction response excluded.

software_gain_chain.qualification: Stationary current-software analytic estimate only, not tapped sample ranges, threshold occupancy or hardware evidence. Upper square and octave Pulse sum atunity; removing Pulse DC does not remove square H1. LP fixed point has unity DC. Quiet final levels follow post-shaper attenuation.

inferences: Both models fail the predeclared global-calibration guard: all 27 A01 total/odd harmonic settings worsen; A03/A05 candidate closure remains censored.
Broad improvements on A02/A05 do not repair primary timing and harmonic-body failures. No aggregate ranking or per-case selection.
Current software gain staging can keep the declared shapers outside their small linear centers; no hardware transfer or threshold is identified.
limitations: All performance MIDI is reconstructed; velocity/gates/phase/live edits/capture processing remain unverified.
RCS source encodes are one performance;17 references do not imply 17 independent instruments or sessions.
Window/channel/shift groups overlap and are sensitivity observations, not independent trials or confidence intervals.
A01 includes mixed oscillators/resonant movement; Dist clean Lower confounds driven Upper. A03/A05 retain delay; A05 late high band reaches recording floor.
Absolute source/software powers retain unknown capture gain and are not gain-calibrated.
H2-reference shape requires clean Lower and linear output assumptions; full amplitudes/fit residuals retained.
The fixed shapers are diagnostic replacements, not recovered Roland algorithms.
